title: Gateway response model alias rejects a successful Kimi resume qualification
backend: Claude Code 2.1.203 via Infini Anthropic Messages gateway
target: gfx1151 provider preparation; no GPU task launched

evidence.observation: Resumed stream init.model and result.modelUsage name kimi-k3, assistant response index1 names moonshotai/kimi-k3, later responses name kimi-k3. Structured output and both planned candidate updates succeeded. Original failed qualification is retained.
evidence.model_list_observation: Authenticated /v1/models returned exact request id kimi-k3; no token is retained in this finding.

observation: Exact response name equality rejects an otherwise complete invocation. Accepting aliases by basename would hide undeclared model changes.
proposed_change: Caller-declared response-model allowlist is frozen in provider configuration and qualification; request/init/primary modelUsage remain exact. Preserve native names and all candidate/lifecycle guards. Apply identical authority to fault usage and replay.

verified_by.result: Original failed stream rejects without declaration, accepts only with moonshotai/kimi-k3 explicitly declared; two retained candidates, 30364 tokens, raw events unchanged.
verified_by.scope: Software protocol replay; no retroactive qualification or GPU performance claim.
